explanation: Count the exact characters required by the letter. Spend one needed occurrence for each matching magazine character. The letter is constructible exactly when every needed occurrence has been supplied; spaces and case remain significant.
timeComplexity: O(L + M) expected time for letter and magazine lengths.
spaceComplexity: O(u) auxiliary space for u distinct letter characters.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
